data.body: Closure/merge evidence: Gerrit 2955 was submitted revision-scoped only after exact reviewed PS1 ee10d6c1a5eaeafd102dae0e935226a5d1791d6f held LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments. Gerrit rebased and merged PS2 5b6f41e96cc78394082ef5ca22beb22f4aa7cd8f, reachable from origin/main. Sixteen of 18 ticket-owned files are byte-identical between reviewed and merged revisions. The two files with concurrent mainline changes preserve all three ticket-owned stable blocks exactly: tests/unit/test_doctor_mapping.py#D:<module> (SHA-256 a44eeb3f...), tests/unit/test_doctor_mapping.py#D:test_doctor_cli_mcp_client_scan_is_hermetic (c723fb8f...), and tests/unit/test_doctor_mcp_client.py#D:<module> (e361867b...). Their other differences are the separately landed doctor behavior tests/call wiring outside this ticket’s stable-block allowlist. The existing 36-row non-author receipt remains applicable (digest 05504006c4737dd466499c4a029bc2166c71cf611699431868d0077e354d9692). Reconciled the completion oracle to the operator-directed four scoped commands plus Gerrit CI, removed only obsolete make verify, and marked the criteria proven by recorded validation/review evidence. Pending one fresh plan review and completion close; no full local suite or force.
